decision: accepted scoped native-play UI execution evidence
proof_limits: These are CPU subprocess integration tests with disposable fixtures, not a new public packaged-shipping or source-deleted player proof.
Viewport resize remains a separate presentation transaction; later physical-input or guest errors are not claimed to roll it back.
No native-window, GPU, OS IME, visual, live-provider or device-performance execution.
Existing save/static guest and unsupported-consumer restrictions are unchanged.
observations: Actual CLI native-play, one-shot play.run and six incremental play.step calls produce equal six-tick UI logs with focus/preedit/cancel/commit/resize and UI-owned Enter filtering.
Actual authored font is imported and its source font deleted before play; project, behavior source and original authoring journal remain byte-identical.
Shared typed resolver checks oversized/malformed/wrong-focus records before UI publication; failed guest is terminal and retained accepted UI remains unchanged.
Wrong-target and trapping one-shot candidates preserve previous completed native Play session; invalid CLI viewport/camera/target routes publish no PCM.
PreparedPlay to paused PlaySession preserves UI settings after project/source-directory deletion; no-fallback invalid startup tests cover early refusal.
